market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely volatile in near term. S&P 500's best day in a month on easing rate-hike bets is counterbalanced by $97 oil, Iran escalation, and 10Y yield at multi-year highs. Expect choppy trading with energy and defense outperforming, consumer discretionary lagging. Yen intervention risk adds FX volatility. OPEC+ Sunday decision is key catalyst. September seasonality historically weak for equities.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle and semiconductor demand provide structural equity support over 6-12 months. However, sustained oil above $90 and tariff policy shifts could keep inflation sticky, delaying rate cuts. K-shaped economy means dispersion, not broad-based rallies. Geopolitical risk premium (Iran, trade policy) remains embedded in pricing. Bond markets may stabilize if inflation data cools, supporting duration re-entry in H2 2026.
